department: Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering

fee_waiver.value: Between Sept. 1 and Dec. 1 the department considers waiving the fee for international PhD applicants with a bachelor's GPA of at least 3.80/4.00 (or equivalent).
fee_waiver.quote: between Sept. 1 and Dec. 1, the department will consider waiving the application fee for international students seeking a PhD degree who have an undergraduate (bachelor) GPA greater than or equal to 3.80/4.00

gre_general.value: The GRE is not part of the review.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is no longer a requirement for admission to our graduate program and it is not part of our review process.

toefl_min.value: Chemical and Biological Engineering requires TOEFL iBT 100.

ielts_min.value: Chemical and Biological Engineering requires IELTS 7.5.

funding.value: Full financial support is available to admitted PhD students through assistantships and fellowships, with no separate application.
funding.quote: Full financial support is available to admitted PhD students in the form of assistantships and fellowships.

entry_route.value: A baccalaureate degree is the requirement; the department emphasizes the PhD and takes no terminal-master's applicants.
entry_route.quote: Hold a baccalaureate degree or its equivalent from an accredited college or university. | The department emphasizes the PhD degree and does not accept applications from students seeking a terminal master’s degree.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Not stated on the pages checked
